Artificial Press-On Nails Combo Set – Vibrant Colors & Trendy Designs | Reusable & Easy to Apply Nail Art Kit for All Occasions | Artificial Nails
Elevate your nail game with this Combo Artificial Press-On Nails Set, featuring 14 stylish designs packed in 7 convenient combos (2 designs per pack). From bold rainbow colors and ombré finishes to floral prints and glitter details, each combo offers a unique pair of nail sets to suit every mood and occasion. These press-on nails are reusable, easy to apply, and comfortable to wear—ideal for DIY manicures at home, parties, or gifting.
Crafted for both style and comfort, each set includes 12 pre-shaped nails that fit most finger sizes. Whether you're into vibrant shades or elegant patterns, this value-packed combo brings salon-quality nails to your fingertips without the salon price.
